Definition: defence, high fort (tower), refuge, Misgab, a place in Moab
BiblicalUsage: The word is a high tower, a defence, a refuge, and David uses it for God Himself. The LORD is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer, the God of Jacob is our refuge, and He only is my rock and my salvation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tower is the right picture. A refuge is not a hiding place you dig, it is a height you run to, and the God who is my defence cannot be taken.
